data.name: Khabeer
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Prophet Khidr, also known as Khabeer, was a wise and righteous servant of Allah. He was given the power to live for centuries, and he used it to help people and guide them towards the right path. The name Khabeer means 'the gatherer' or 'the one who is aware'. It symbolizes the importance of knowledge, wisdom, and righteousness.
